downstreamHost.description: Base URL of the backend API, e.g. https://pets.example.com. The endpoint path is appended to it.

endpoints.description:
Endpoints exposed as MCP tools, in the light-4j endpoint format {path}@{method}, e.g. /v1/pets/{petId}@get.
The path includes the base path of the spec's first servers URL. Tools are listed in this order.
The format is a YAML list, or a JSON array or comma-separated string in values.yml.

maxResponseBodySize.description: Maximum size of a backend response body, in bytes. A larger body is replaced by an error message.
